# Feature: Collectors Web CDP + OS

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-14 — issue #16 -->

## Intent
Findings need samples with a monotonic timestamp (FR-014). Web (CDP/Performance) and OS (process tree, CPU, RSS) collectors write onto the same run timeline. A missing collector is `unsupported`, never a silent null (EDGE-010).

Roadmap: Epic 2 Web CLI.

## Preconditions
- Artifact store (#5) and web doctor (#14) exist
- `sampleSchema` in `packages/schemas` already requires finite `value` and `timestampNs`

## Happy Path
- [ ] A short fixture-style collect produces samples from at least one browser (`cdp`) and one OS (`os`) source
- [ ] Samples have integer `timestampNs` monotonic per source and an explicit `unit`
- [ ] NaN/Infinity are rejected at ingest
- [ ] Touched files: zero type escape hatches

## Edge Cases
- [ ] Missing CDP → capability `unsupported`; collection is not a budget fail
- [ ] CDP connect timeout → capability `incomplete`; dependent rules stay skip
- [ ] Child processes appear in the captured process tree (EDGE-004)
- [ ] Request bodies / Authorization headers are not stored on samples (NFR-006)

## Regression
- [ ] `potato doctor` still works with injected env
- [ ] `pnpm checks` does not require a Playwright browser download
- [ ] Scope: `packages/collector-hub/**`, `packages/collector-os/**`, `packages/adapter-web/**` — no dashboard

## Assumptions
- Collectors are injectable; unit tests do not launch Chromium
- OS default sampler measures the current Node process; children come from an injected tree
- `potato run` stays a stub; this slice produces samples via collect APIs + tests

## Security Coverage
- F-03: no secrets; ingest keeps only sampleId/source/metric/timestampNs/value/unit
- B-04: no SQL; no shell interpolation
- P-02: CollectorError message/code only
- P-04: N/A (no file writes)
- NFR-006: no request body or Authorization header fields on samples

## Screenshots
Not applicable (CLI/collectors).

## Implementation Notes
- `packages/collector-hub`: ingest on a shared timeline; rejects NaN/Infinity and backwards `timestampNs` per source; stores only sample fields (NFR-006).
- `packages/collector-os`: CPU (`us`) + RSS (`byte`); process tree including injected children (EDGE-004).
- `packages/adapter-web` CDP collector: injected session; missing → `unsupported`; timeout → `incomplete`; `budgetEligible` false so the run is not a budget fail.
- 81 tests; `pnpm checks` green without Playwright download.

## Composition Gate
- Verdict: CLEAR
- HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE (uncommitted issue/16-collectors-web-os)
- Event: collectors emit samples → hub ingest → CollectionReport (capabilities + budgetEligible).
- Missing CDP fails closed (`unsupported`, not a silent zero, not a fail finding).
- No queue/worker/fan-out.
